recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, overlapping collage of fictional banknotes featuring stylized portraits in an intaglio engraving style. The bills use traditional currency motifs—guilloché patterns, circular seals, and heavy borders—but feature non-standard denominations and modern, tattooed figures.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping banknotes create a sense of chaotic abundance
High-contrast black ink against aged, off-white paper texture
Juxtaposition of formal 19th-century engraving with contemporary facial features
Repetition of circular seals and numeric corner indices
coreInvariants: Crumpled and folded paper texture overlays
Desaturated green and black color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple banknotes are scattered across the frame at varying angles; two primary bills are centered and fully legible.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central oval portraits of the figures serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal lines of the overlapping bills, moving from the top-left to the bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is a 'full bleed' collage with very little background visible.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Sage Green (seals and serial numbers)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between the paper and the ink.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic Roman Serif and Gothic Sans-Serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses wide, heavy serifs with internal decorative inline stripes
Supporting text uses condensed, monospaced sans-serifs
All text features a slight 'ink bleed' or 'distressed' texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Large numeric indices in corners are heavily stylized with thick outlines and internal hatching

composition.position: Top and bottom banners of the bills

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A decorative, arched display serif paired with a functional, typewriter-style sans-serif for serial numbers.

preserve: Arched layout of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and historical authority
Matches the specific aesthetic of currency printing

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a collage of overlapping, crumpled banknotes with intricate borders, circular seals, and central oval portraits of bearded men with tattoos in a black-and-white engraved style. Use an aged paper texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply arched slab-serif text to the top and bottom banners of the bills. Add monospaced green serial numbers and small-scale sans-serif metadata text to match the currency layout.

verificationChecks: Text follows the perspective and folds of the paper
Engraving lines are consistent across portraits and borders
Color palette remains muted and desaturated

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the green accent color
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the portraits to avoid direct likeness

mustAchieve: Realistic paper fiber and fold details

postGenerationChecks: Are the portraits rendered in a cross-hatched engraving style?
Does the text appear printed onto the textured paper rather than floating above it?
Is the overlapping of the bills logical and layered?
Are the guilloché patterns sufficiently complex?
recipe.reuseFormula: Currency Collage Style: [Subject] portraits + [Denomination] values + Engraved Line Art + Aged Paper Texture + Arched Slab-Serif Typography.
